pathStyleHint: Use path-style access (bucket in path instead of domain)
prefixHint: Directory prefix in bucket, e.g. siyuan-backup/
backupNowHintNone: No backup mode selected. Please enable one in the Backup Mode section of the Config tab
confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this backup?
confirmRestore: Download this backup to local backup directory? You'll need to extract manually to restore.
s3BackupDesc: Backup workspace to S3-compatible storage, supports local ZIP + S3 upload
useDateFolderHint: When checked, files are stored under a date folder (e.g. siyuan-backup/20260706-012735/). When unchecked, files go directly under the prefix
backupModeHint: The three modes can be combined freely; execution order: local ZIP → S3 upload → S3 incremental
localZipHint: Pack as data-*.zip saved to workspace data-backup/ directory
s3UploadHint: Upload files one by one to S3-compatible storage (requires S3 configuration)
autoBackupEnabledHint: Auto backup is enabled, will run at the configured frequency
autoBackupDisabledHint: Enable to automatically backup workspace at the configured frequency
dropHint: Drop files here to compute SHA-256
confirmRemoveChecksum: Are you sure you want to delete this checksum?
confirmClearAll: Are you sure you want to clear all checksums?
confirmClearLogs: Are you sure you want to clear all logs?
s3IncrementalHint: Only upload new or changed files in data/ to S3 (requires S3 configuration)
incrementalFirstRun: First incremental backup, all files will be uploaded
incrementalResult: Incremental backup finished: uploaded {uploaded}, skipped {skipped}, deleted {deleted}
incrementalEmptyScan: Scan result is empty, incremental backup aborted
incrementalManifestCorrupt: Failed to parse remote manifest, treated as first backup
confirmIncrementalRestore: Download all incremental backup files according to the remote manifest? Files will be saved to a restore folder under the local backup directory (data/ will not be overwritten); replace manually to restore.
incrementalNoManifest: No incremental backup manifest found on remote, please run an incremental backup first
s3NotConfigured: S3 is not configured, please complete the S3 connection configuration first
noFilesToBackup: No files to backup in workspace
closeWhileBackingUp: Backup in progress; closing the window will not interrupt it. Hide the window?
autoBackupSkippedBusy: Another backup task is running, this auto backup was skipped
guideEndpoint: S3 service address without http:// prefix, e.g. 192.168.1.100:5244
guideKeys: Obtain from the S3 service admin console. OpenList generates them in the Object Storage settings
guideBucket: Bucket name, must match the bucket created on the S3 server
guideRegion: Region identifier. For self-hosted services like MinIO / OpenList, us-east-1 usually works
guidePathStyle: Required for self-hosted services (MinIO, OpenList, Ceph); usually unchecked for AWS S3 / Cloudflare R2
guideSSL: Check when the server has an HTTPS certificate or reverse proxy; usually unchecked for local services
uploadTimeoutHint: Timeout for a single upload request; increase for large files or slow networks. Default 240 seconds
allFilesExist: All files already exist on S3, {skipped} skipped
